feature: GNU PAX sparse logical content and original member names
rootCause: Pinned TarIn ignores GNU.sparse attributes, leaving packed extent bytes and the v1 map as ordinary content. Returning S_FALSE on invalid maps lets native autodetection reopen at a later header and discard sparse metadata.
fix: Parse GNU PAX sparse 0.0/0.1/1.0, reuse native sparse stream, set logical size and original name, consume aligned v1 map blocks, validate ordered extents and exact packed length, limit maps to 65536 records, and return E_FAIL on invalid sparse metadata. Preserve scalar/map last-value semantics and repeated v0 offset/length pairs.

after.basis: Untouched authored original bytes, independently checked with Python tarfile and macOS bsdtar; first-fixed/report.json plus regression test.
